map.🏋️ 羊水指数(AFI)正常范围评估器: 🏋️ Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI) Normal Range Assessor
map.四象限最大羊水池深度之和评估羊水量，诊断羊水过少/过多: Sum of the deepest vertical pockets in four quadrants to assess amniotic fluid volume, diagnosing oligo-/polyhydramnios
map.📖 查看「羊水指数(AFI)正常范围评估器 使用指南」: 📖 View "Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI) Normal Range Assessor User Guide"
map.以脐为十字将腹部分四象限，测各象限最大羊水池垂直深度(不含肢体/脐带): Divide the abdomen into four quadrants using the umbilicus as a cross, and measure the deepest vertical pocket in each (excluding limbs/umbilical cord)
map.AFI = Dα + Dβ + Dγ + Dδ（四个象限最大羊水池垂直深度之和）: AFI = Dα + Dβ + Dγ + Dδ (sum of the deepest vertical pockets in four quadrants); SDP = single deepest pocket
map.羊水指数按四象限深度求和；AFI 5–24 cm 为正常，<5 cm 羊水过少，: AFI sums the four-quadrant depths; AFI 5–24 cm is normal, <5 cm oligohydramnios, >24 cm polyhydramnios; SDP 2–8 cm is normal.
map.注：AFI≤5为羊水过少，5.1–8为临界偏少。不同孕周羊水量参考范围略有差异。: Note: AFI ≤ 5 indicates oligohydramnios; 5.1–8 is borderline low. Reference ranges vary slightly by gestational week.
map.🔬 羊水量异常的病因: 🔬 Causes of Abnormal Amniotic Fluid Volume
map.胎儿因素：泌尿道畸形(肾缺如、尿道梗阻)、FGR、胎膜早破: Fetal factors: urinary tract anomalies (renal agenesis, urethral obstruction), FGR, premature rupture of membranes
map.母体因素：脱水、子痫前期、过期妊娠、药物(ACEI/NSAIDs): Maternal factors: dehydration, preeclampsia, post-term pregnancy, drugs (ACE inhibitors/NSAIDs)
map.胎儿因素：消化道/中枢神经系统畸形、染色体异常、胎儿水肿: Fetal factors: GI/CNS malformations, chromosomal abnormalities, fetal hydrops
map.母体因素：妊娠糖尿病(最常见)、Rh血型不合: Maternal factors: gestational diabetes (most common), Rh incompatibility
map.特发性：约30%原因不明: Idiopathic: about 30% have no identifiable cause
map.提示：羊水量反映胎儿泌尿、消化功能及胎盘状况。羊水过少与胎儿窘迫、肺发育不良相关: Tip: amniotic fluid reflects fetal renal and digestive function and placental status. Oligohydramnios is associated with fetal distress and pulmonary hypoplasia; polyhydramnios raises the risk of preterm birth and malpresentation. This tool is for ultrasound assessment reference only.
map.孕晚期超声测四个象限羊水最大暗区，求和得 AFI，判断羊水量是否过少或过多。: In the third trimester, ultrasound measures the largest pocket in four quadrants; summing them yields AFI to judge whether fluid is too low or too high.
map.怀疑胎膜早破或胎儿生长受限时，用 AFI 快速筛查羊水过少。: Use AFI to quickly screen for oligohydramnios when premature rupture of membranes or fetal growth restriction is suspected.
map.妊娠期糖尿病或胎儿畸形排查时，监测 AFI 排除羊水过多。: Monitor AFI to rule out polyhydramnios during work-up of gestational diabetes or fetal anomalies.
map.四象限分别为 4cm、5cm、4cm、5cm，AFI = 4+5+4+5 = 1: Quadrants are 4, 5, 4 and 5 cm; AFI = 4+5+4+5 = 18 cm, within the normal 8–25 cm range.
map.四象限 2cm、1cm、1cm、1cm，AFI = 5cm，恰好触线，按规范判为: Quadrants 2, 1, 1 and 1 cm; AFI = 5 cm, right at the cutoff, classified as oligohydramnios by guideline; rule out PROM and placental insufficiency.
map.AFI 和最大羊水池（SDP）有什么区别？: What is the difference between AFI and the single deepest pocket (SDP)?
map.AFI 是四象限之和，对羊水偏少更敏感；SDP 看最大单一暗区。一般 AFI<5: AFI is the sum of four quadrants and is more sensitive to low fluid; SDP looks at the single largest pocket. Generally AFI <5 cm or SDP <2 cm both indicate oligohydramnios; clinical diagnosis often combines both.
map.AFI 偏高一定有问题吗？: Does a high AFI always mean a problem?
map.25–30cm 为轻度增多，>30cm 为羊水过多，需排查妊娠期糖尿病、胎儿消化: 25–30 cm is mild increase, >30 cm is polyhydramnios; investigate gestational diabetes, fetal GI anomalies or chromosomal abnormalities, but isolated mild increase can occur in normal pregnancy.
map.关于「羊水指数(AFI)正常范围评估器」: About the "Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI) Normal Range Assessor"
map.羊水指数(AFI)正常范围评估器，四象限羊水指数测量评估羊水过少与过多，指导临床: The AFI Normal Range Assessor measures the four-quadrant amniotic fluid index to evaluate oligo- and polyhydramnios and guide clinical intervention. A professional medical tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
